blocks.title: Read-only scope
blocks.content: The direct App-only route has no user context and cannot perform account actions. Writes such as bookmarks or Articles require the separate xurl OAuth bridge and are intentionally not hidden behind this Ability.

## Security

Use a dedicated X app and grant only the scopes you need. Vetta sends the Bearer Token only to `https://api.x.com/mcp` over HTTPS; never paste the token into prompts, source files or shared logs. X API usage remains subject to X rate limits and developer terms.
